Discover upcoming hidden gem events in Washington, DC

The Clockout DC framework

We share thousands of hidden gem events each year—many of which never grace the page of mainstream media. While we won’t promise you love every event, here’s what we can promise:

  • locally-vetted

    Founder Jade was born in DC, grew up in Arlington, and resides in Union Market—and has continued to explore culturally-enriching events throughout each phase of life.

  • straight from the source

    We dig through 100+ primary sources each week to find hidden-gem events our neighbors will love, never consolidating research from other news outlets.

  • anti-algorithm

    What’s the point of sharing events that are constantly sold-out? We help DC locals discover untapped events to fit their interest, background, or lifestyle.

  • your neighbor

    We highlight events we know we, or our neighbors, would enjoy.
